title: Counit-transpose cancellation for the smooth exceptional comparison
statement:
Fix the finite coefficient datum of [def-pur-conventions]: $k$ is the fixed algebraic closure of $\mathbf F_q$ of characteristic $p$, $\ell\ne p$, and $A=A_{E,n}=\mathcal O_E/\varpi_E^n$ with $n\geq1$. Let $X,Y,Y'$ be finite-type $k$-schemes, let $f:X\to Y$ be a separated finite-type $k$-morphism and let $v:Y'\to Y$ be an arbitrary $k$-morphism [def-weil-scheme-morphism-properties]. Form the Cartesian square [def-cbc-compact-support-square] with $X'=X\times_YY'$, projections $u:X'\to X$ and $f':X'\to Y'$, so $f\circ u=v\circ f'$. Choose a compactification $c=(j,p)$, $X\xrightarrow{j}\overline X\xrightarrow{p}Y$ with $j$ a quasi-compact open immersion and $p$ proper [def-weil-compactifications-refinements], and let $c'=(j',p')$ be its pullback. Then $\overline X$ and $\overline X'=\overline X\times_YY'$ are finite-type $k$-schemes, so they have finite dimension and [thm-sf-ambient-adjoint-class] applies to $c$ and $c'$.

Use the ordinary constant-$A$ module derived categories on the small etale and pro-etale sites [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories, def-weil-pbc-proetale-modules]. For each scheme $T$ write $C_T=\nu_T^*$ for the exact derived comparison pullback [def-sf-comparison-derived-pullback], $U_T=R\nu_{T,*}$, and $\eta_T:\operatorname{id}\xrightarrow{\sim}U_TC_T$ for the unit on $D^+(T_{\mathrm{et}},A)$ [thm-weil-pbc-site-comparison]. For every arrow $q:T'\to T$ write $\kappa_q:C_{T'}q_{\mathrm{et}}^*\xrightarrow{\sim}Lq_{\mathrm{proet}}^*C_T$ for the canonical comparison of [lem-weil-pbc-comparison-pullback]. Put $F_c^e=Rp_{\mathrm{et},*}j_!^{\mathrm{et}}$ [def-amb-etale-compact-support], $F_c^p=Rp_{\mathrm{proet},*}j_!^{\mathrm{proet}}$, and similarly $F_{c'}^e,F_{c'}^p$. For $N\in D^+(X_{\mathrm{et}},A)$ let $C_{c,N}:C_YF_c^eN\xrightarrow{\sim}F_c^pC_XN$ be the canonical compact-support comparison, the inverse of the map of [lem-sf-class-compact-support-comparison] for the identity witness, built from the extension-by-zero and normalized proper direct-image comparisons as in [lem-pur-co-smooth-exchange-transport]; define $C_{c',N'}$ for $N'\in D^+(X'_{\mathrm{et}},A)$ in the same way. Put
$$S_N=Lv^*(C_{c,N})\circ\kappa_{v,F_c^eN},\qquad T_N=F_{c'}^p(\kappa_{u,N})\circ C_{c',u_{\mathrm{et}}^*N}.$$
Let $E^e_N:v_{\mathrm{et}}^*F_c^eN\to F_{c'}^eu_{\mathrm{et}}^*N$ be the compact-support exchange of [def-cbc-exchange-map], an isomorphism by [thm-cbc-finite-torsion], and let $E^p_{C_XN}:Lv^*F_c^pC_XN\to F_{c'}^pLu^*C_XN$ be the chosen-compactification pro-etale exchange of [lem-pur-co-smooth-exchange-transport]. By that lemma $T_N\circ C_{Y'}(E^e_N)=E^p_{C_XN}\circ S_N$, so $E^p_{C_XN}$ is an isomorphism.

Let $R=f_c^\times$ and $R'=f'^\times_{c'}$ be the ordinary etale right adjoints of $F_c^e$ and $F_{c'}^e$ [thm-amb-etale-exceptional-adjoint], with counits $\varepsilon^e,\varepsilon'^e$ and Hom bijection $J'$ for $F_{c'}^e\dashv R'$. Let $G\in D^+(Y_{\mathrm{et}},A)$ be such that $M=RG$ and $R'v_{\mathrm{et}}^*G$ are bounded below. Define
$$\varepsilon^p_G=C_Y(\varepsilon^e_G)\circ C_{c,M}^{-1}:F_c^pC_XM\to C_YG.$$

(1) As maps $C_{Y'}F_{c'}^eu_{\mathrm{et}}^*M\to C_{Y'}v_{\mathrm{et}}^*G$,
$$\kappa_{v,G}^{-1}\circ Lv^*(\varepsilon^p_G)\circ(E^p_{C_XM})^{-1}\circ T_M=C_{Y'}\bigl(v_{\mathrm{et}}^*\varepsilon^e_G\circ(E^e_M)^{-1}\bigr).$$

(2) Let $\beta^e_G:u_{\mathrm{et}}^*M\to R'v_{\mathrm{et}}^*G$ be the $J'$-transpose of $v_{\mathrm{et}}^*\varepsilon^e_G\circ(E^e_M)^{-1}$. Use for $F_{c'}^p$ and $H'=C_{X'}R'U_{Y'}$ the transported bounded-below Hom bijection of [thm-sf-ambient-adjoint-class], normalized as in [def-weil-exceptional-inverse-image]: for $N'\in D^+(X'_{\mathrm{et}},A)$ and $L\in D^+(Y'_{\mathrm{proet}},A)$ it sends $z:F_{c'}^pC_{X'}N'\to L$ to $C_{X'}\bigl(J'(U_{Y'}(z\circ C_{c',N'})\circ\eta_{Y',F_{c'}^eN'})\bigr)$, and on an input with witness $\alpha:C_{X'}N'\xrightarrow{\sim}K'$ one first precomposes with $F_{c'}^p\alpha$ and finally precomposes with $\alpha^{-1}$. Let $\beta^p_G:Lu^*C_XM\to H'Lv^*C_YG$ be the transpose, for the witness $\kappa_{u,M}$, of $Lv^*(\varepsilon^p_G)\circ(E^p_{C_XM})^{-1}$. Then
$$\beta^p_G\circ\kappa_{u,M}=C_{X'}R'\bigl(U_{Y'}(\kappa_{v,G})\circ\eta_{Y',v_{\mathrm{et}}^*G}\bigr)\circ C_{X'}(\beta^e_G),$$
that is, the pro-etale counit-transpose comparison is the conjugate of $C_{X'}(\beta^e_G)$ under the isomorphisms $\kappa_{u,M}$ and $C_{X'}R'(U_{Y'}(\kappa_{v,G})\circ\eta_{Y',v_{\mathrm{et}}^*G})$. Both identities are natural in $G$. No separatedness of $X$, $Y$ or $Y'$, no smoothness of $f$ and no invertibility of $\beta^e_G$ or $\beta^p_G$ is assumed, and no adjunction on all pro-etale objects is used.

source.place: Transport of compact-support base change and transposition: the counit substitution and cancellation identifying the two transposes.

from.place: Proof, sentences: 'By [thm-cbc-finite-level-proetale], compact-support base change transports to the stated site. The adjunction bijections and counits transport by [thm-sf-ambient-adjoint-class], so the realized map is precisely the comparison in the statement, not merely an isomorphism between its source and target.'
